adelaide-hills-21.name: Kyeema Conservation Park
adelaide-hills-21.bio: Stringybark woodland park south of Adelaide with walking trails and more than 80 recorded bird species.

notes.pin: No coordinate in draft; take the park's visitor/car park point from NPWS maps or OSM, not the centroid.
notes.cost: parks.sa.gov.au: Free entry; open daily; closed on Catastrophic Fire Danger days. Page says it is on the Fleurieu Peninsula, 60.9 km from Adelaide; destination tag adelaide-hills is Atlas's, check span and placement.
notes.other: Former prison camp history in draft bio not on the park page, so left out of the bio.

para-wirra-conservation-park.name: Para Wirra Conservation Park
para-wirra-conservation-park.bio: Northern Adelaide Hills park with walks, a campground, grazing kangaroos and the Barossa Goldfields mining ruins.
para-wirra-conservation-park.coordinates_source: pending serial pin pass (draft: Wikipedia article point, a centroid)

notes.pin: Draft point is the Wikipedia centroid; use the western vehicle entry gate off Para Wirra Road or the main picnic ground car park.
notes.cost: parks.sa.gov.au: vehicle entry $14.40 per vehicle, must be paid before entry; camping from $27.50/night. Western gate open sunrise to sunset except Christmas Day. Park closed 6pm-midnight Wednesdays 1/9/2026-31/8/2027 for pest control (irrelevant to day visits).
notes.other: Mack Creek Hike and Lake Discovery Walk named on the agency's Adelaide Hills page, not the park page.

adelaide-international-bird-sanctuary-na.name: Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary National Park
adelaide-international-bird-sanctuary-na.bio: Coastal national park north of Adelaide on a migratory flyway, protecting resident and visiting shorebirds.
adelaide-international-bird-sanctuary-na.coordinates_source: pending serial pin pass (draft: Wikipedia article point, a centroid)

notes.pin: Draft is the park centroid. The park is split into units along 60 km of coast; pick the main visitor point (e.g. the Parham or Thompson Beach birdwatching area) but not Thompson Beach's own pin (thompson-beach is a separate spot).
notes.cost: parks.sa.gov.au: Free entry, 28.25 km from Adelaide. Alert: Buckland Park area closed on selected days 11 May 2026-10 May 2027 for pest control.
notes.other: Official name carries 'Winaityinaityi Pangkara'; kept out of name per naming rule.

thompson-beach.name: Thompson Beach
thompson-beach.bio: Samphire coast beach town on the Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary, known for migratory shorebirds from October to April.
thompson-beach.coordinates_source: pending serial pin pass (draft coordinate, source unrecorded)

notes.pin: Draft has 6 decimals; confirm against OSM natural=beach or the birdwatching car park at the beach.
notes.cost: Open access coastal settlement and beach; no agency page of its own.
notes.ticket: No single official site (open beach and shack settlement).

thompson-beach.ticket_note: Open beach with no single steward; Wikivoyage sanctuary page and NPWS name it, neither is an official site for the beach.
